arxiv:2406.06427.title: Notes on Kalman Filter (KF, EKF, ESKF, IEKF, IESKF)
arxiv:2406.06427.why: Wikipedia's Extended Kalman filter article states the predict and update equations without deriving them, and the EKF sheet said so. Section 4 here linearises f and h by first-order Taylor expansion, defines the Jacobians, and carries the linear model through the Kalman prediction and correction steps.
